fitting.key: (MASTER_SEED, wave 1, 300, family fitting group, 0, seed_id, BOOTSTRAP_STREAM)

plan_schema.sharing: within a family, first-wave (D-2) and added (D-3b) configurations of both systems share the SAME plan objects / identities (same family latent => identical cluster UIDs); evaluation and fitting stay separate purposes
plan_schema.fixation: built once at the start of the formal calibration from the bank UIDs; identity (plan ids, rng keys, multiplicity SHAs) recorded and unchanged through the target evaluation; never per threshold; no unrecorded keys
